thread:
asha: Heads-up — HawkEye wants a pilot with Dedicated capacity for 3 months. They asked if we can do a 45% off pilot rate to match a competing vendor.
kevin-ps: do we know expected token volume / peak qps for the pilot? that changes economics a lot.
asha: rough numbers: ~20M tokens / month, peaks at 200 qps during business hours. They'd like access to our r5-dedicated skus.
jena-security: HawkEye is asking for SOC2 and an on-prem data handling clause — that won't change pricing but could add ops cost if we need a bespoke cert scope.
tom-deals: copy. pricing floor for Dedicated pilots is 25% off with a minimum monthly commit. 45% is outside standard playbook. Need justify: strategic logo? expansion path?
asha: strategic for their sector, likely enterprise buy after pilot if perf/ops look good. Could commit to 6mo if pilot succeeds.
kevin-ps: technical note: their model size will require multi-GPU instances for inference; continuous batching helps, but custom kernel tuning may be needed (one-time eng effort). estimate: $8-12k eng ops uplift.
tom-deals: ok — two levers: increase commit length or include a one-time engineering fee to keep discount within margin. finance will want ARR math.
dealbot: @tom-deals please attach the completed Deal Desk Form (https://redwood.internal/deals) and include expected ARR, pilot duration, and ENG uplift estimate. Auto-rule: discounts >30% require VP-Sales signoff.
asha: filling the form now. putting 6mo pilot, projected ARR $350k if converted, eng uplift $10k, pilot commit $15k/mo.
jenA-security: small correction — please note they require data residency clause for EU customers. flagged for legal review.
tom-deals: thanks. based on numbers, finance ok to consider up to 35% if we add the $10k engineering fee and a conversion commitment (30% of pilot-months credited on conversion). anything above 35% needs VP-Sales.
asha: can we do 35% + $10k engineering fee and a 12-month conversion target? I'll push in the contract.
kevin-ps: +1 technically — that package covers our ops and kernel tuning risk.
tom-deals: i'll route to finance + elena (VP Sales) for signoff. ETA 24h. :thumbsup:
dealbot: Signoff requested to @elena-vp-sales. Approval path: Finance -> VP Sales -> Legal.
asha: great, thanks all. will update thread when I get elena's response.
